name: clean-gguf
why: A well-formed model whose declarations match its tensors. The most important case in the corpus: everything here is a false positive, and a scanner that reports anything has failed.

name: precision-drift
why: Declares F16 while every tensor is Q4_K. Precision drives memory, throughput and accuracy, so a quantized model presented as full precision misrepresents all three. This is the axis no scanner that only reads headers can see.

name: parameter-drift
why: Declares 7 billion parameters and carries two million. Requires summing tensor shapes rather than trusting general.parameter_count.

name: executable-chat-template
why: A chat template that reaches for the interpreter. The template ships inside the metadata block and runs where the model is served.

name: benign-chat-template
why: TRAP. An ordinary Jinja chat template with loops and conditionals. Templates are normal; a scanner that flags every template is unusable on real models.

gguf.name: Normal-7B
gguf.chatTemplate: {% for m in messages %}{% if m['role'] == 'user' %}User: {{ m['content'] }}{% else %}Assistant: {{ m['content'] }}{% endif %}{% endfor %}

name: pickle-beside-model
why: A protocol-2 pickle carrying a GLOBAL opcode, sitting next to a clean model. Found only by walking the directory, not by parsing the model file.

name: not-really-a-pickle
why: TRAP. A file named .pkl that is plain text. Extension-based detection reports it; reading the bytes does not. This is the exact failure mode published against picklescan.

files.notes.pkl: this is not a pickle, it is a text file with a misleading name\n

name: trust-remote-code
why: config.json enables trust_remote_code, which runs code shipped with the weights.

name: trust-remote-code-disabled
why: TRAP. The key is present and false. Matching on the key name rather than the value reports it; that is a false positive on a correctly configured model.

name: config-declares-other-precision
why: config.json says float16 while the tensors are Q4_K. The declaration lives beside the model rather than inside it, so this needs both files read and reconciled.
